create_FindReceptacleTool: create a FindReceptacleTool instance with a skill config to find furniture by natural language description
set_environment: set the EnvironmentInterface on a FindReceptacleTool to access the world graph for receptacle lookup
set_llm: set the BaseLLM on a FindReceptacleTool to enable prompt generation and LLM-based receptacle matching
process_high_level_action: process a natural language furniture query through the LLM to find the exact Furniture node name
get_receptacles_list: get a formatted list of all receptacles grouped by type from the environment world graph
